camp_q3.title: CAMP4 Q3 2026 update
camp_q3.supports: Regulatory clearance; first patient expected by year-end, not yet human efficacy.

camp_10q.title: CAMP4 Q3 10-Q
camp_10q.supports: Drug-specific mouse rescue and human dosing plan; sponsor claims, not independent human validation.

needham.title: Needham initiation
needham.url: ../../sources/user-provided/sellside/2026-10-15-CAMP.OQ-Needham  Company In-Summit Push Begins in SYNGAP1 - Initiating Coverage with a B...-124964472.pdf
needham.supports: pp.7-8 preclinical; p.28 DCF 25%; p.29 peak multiple 25%; no matched-cohort derivation identified.

bio.title: BIO/Informa/QLS 2011-2020 study
bio.supports: Executive summary: Phase-I-to-approval 7.9% all; 17.0% rare disease; distinct stage-transition methodology, not our cohort.

spinraza.title: Biogen FDA approval announcement
spinraza.supports: First US approval; genetically defined motor-neuron disease.

qalsody.title: FDA Qalsody approval
qalsody.supports: Accelerated approval based on NfL; not proof of a transferable SYNGAP1 surrogate.

zilganersen.title: FDA Zanvastro approval
zilganersen.supports: First approved Alexander disease therapy; pediatric and adult; toxic-protein lowering.

gtx_failure.title: Ultragenyx Aspire result
gtx_failure.supports: Primary cognition and key secondary MDRI endpoints missed; failure known before Needham initiation.

gtx_winddown.title: Ultragenyx Q3 10-Q
gtx_winddown.supports: GTX-102 discussion: winding down program after failed pivotal trial.

stk_q3.title: Stoke Q3 2026 update
stk_q3.supports: EMPEROR ongoing; planned readout Q3 2027, not approved.

stk_entry.title: Stoke Q2 10-Q
stk_entry.supports: First patient dosed August 2020, later than registered June 2020 study start.

stk_trial.title: Zorevunersen clinical publication
stk_trial.supports: Uncontrolled early clinical data; closer restoration/DEE evidence, not randomized proof.

fusion.title: Ionis FUSION result
fusion.supports: Positive pivotal clinical result, not approval.

fus_early.title: FUS ASO original clinical/preclinical study
fus_early.supports: Individualized human use preceded 2021 group trial; prevents treating Phase 3 entry as first exposure.

rugo_trial.title: Rugonersen TANGELO original trial
rugo_trial.supports: Open-label pediatric restoration ASO, distinct silencing mechanism from CAMP.

rugo_phase3.title: BEACON registry
rugo_phase3.supports: OHB Pediatrics sponsor; ongoing Phase III, not Roche exit equals failure.

wave_old.title: Wave PRECISION-HD sponsor results
wave_old.supports: Two separate compounds discontinued; shared platform/target dependence.

wave004.title: Wave C9 program community letter
wave004.supports: Biomarker reduction without clinical benefit; discontinuation.

wave003.title: Wave Q3 10-Q
wave003.supports: WVE-003 remains clinical-stage; efficacy approval unresolved.

biib105.title: Ionis BIIB105 results
biib105.supports: ATXN2 reduced without NfL/clinical benefit; terminated.

biib132.title: Biogen Q1 2023 results
biib132.supports: BIIB132 discontinued under prioritization; do not infer proven biological failure.

biib_exit.title: Biogen Q4 2024 results
biib_exit.supports: BIIB094 and BIIB101 sponsor discontinuation; verify asset continuation separately.

ionis_pipeline.title: Ionis current pipeline
ionis_pipeline.supports: ION464 remains listed; registry HORIZON recruiting after Biogen exit.

biib080.title: Biogen Q2 10-Q
biib080.supports: CELIA primary dose-response missed; sponsor plans continued registrational development.

roche_letter.title: Roche HD sponsor community letter
roche_letter.supports: HD2 and POINT-HD stopped; clinical translation versus chronic animal toxicity, respectively.

nio.title: Novartis PRESERVE trial
nio.supports: Phase III PSP trial ongoing; separate from AD indication.

lafora.title: ION283 first patients sponsor-community announcement
lafora.supports: Investigator-led safety study; first dosing December 2024.

adult_rescue.title: SYNGAP1 adult genetic rescue original study
adult_rescue.supports: Mouse genetic restoration improved selected phenotypes; not CMP-002 human drug evidence.

legacy.title: ASO developer review of first SOD1 candidate
legacy.supports: ISIS333611 superseded by more potent screening/delivery strategy; supporting historical account, not primary adjudication.
